newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday on long liquidation in anticipation of a further fall in prices, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 yen to 3.6 yen per kg weaker.
Benchmark November ended off 1.6 yen at 128.6 yen.
Easier Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and slack demand in rubber producing countries, were mainly blamed for the continuing weakness, the traders said.
"We are watching if the spot June contract will fall below 120.00 yen per gram before its expiry next Tuesday," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
